summary.important_arguments_or_content: Respondents contended that Article 368 contains an absolute, unrestricted power to amend every provision of the Constitution, including fundamental rights, and that no implied limitations exist [Page 2] [Page 43]. Respondents argued that a written Constitution cannot be rigid and that the constituent power is co-extensive with legislative or judicial powers [Page 103].
